reason: Rescuing someone the player cares about beats a boss fight with no bond.
Cass's sacrifice and the costly choice to go back are personal and earned.
The lead pays for Cass and claims him as family; a tighter personal cost.
A costly choice for an old man outweighs a talky pendant hunt.
A betrayal paid off with a kill-or-spare choice beats party errands.
The mother and dog horror and the bargain beat exposition and gunfights.
